title: Your first drawing
summary: Put views of a part on a sheet and add a dimension. An empty design gets the sample hole plate first.

steps.title: Start a sheet
steps.text: You are in the Drawing workspace. Click New Sheet to start an A3 sheet.

steps.title: Place the front view
steps.text: Click Front, then click on the sheet where the view should go.

steps.title: Place the top view
steps.text: Click Top, then click above or below the front view. It lines up with the front view.

steps.title: Dimension the width
steps.text: Click Horizontal, then click the left and the right edge of a view. The dimension follows the model if it changes.

finish: Export the sheet with PDF, SVG or DXF in the EXPORT group. Change the part and the views and dimensions follow.
